basics.title: Data Engineer
basics.summary: Data Engineer specialized in Big Data, reliable data pipelines, and scalable architectures for analytics, BI, and AI/ML use cases.

bullets: Designed and optimized ETL/ELT pipelines using Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and PySpark for analytics and AI/ML use cases.
Implemented a Medallion architecture to govern enterprise data flows and improve data accessibility for BI, predictive modeling, and AI-driven applications.
Designed data models, data warehouses, transformation layers, and curated datasets to support analytics, feature engineering, and machine learning workflows.
Developed web scraping pipelines to collect, clean, and integrate data from external sources.
Orchestrated end-to-end data workflows using Apache Airflow, ensuring reliable scheduling, monitoring, and automation of data pipelines.
Managed data storage on AWS S3 and contributed to the implementation of a scalable Data Lake architecture.
Automated dbt deployments and testing using GitHub Actions and CI/CD best practices, improving reliability, version control, and maintainability.
Collaborated with Data, Product, and Engineering teams to build scalable, high-performance data pipelines and continuously improve the data platform.
Designed and optimized ETL pipelines using Airflow and Python for data ingestion.
Improved DAG reliability and maintainability to support AWS-based delivery.
Contributed to GitLab CI/CD automation, translating business needs into data products.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to facilitate production workflows and self-service usage.
Implemented a RAG pipeline to generate tailored reports from legal and domain-specific knowledge bases.
Prepared and indexed unstructured text in MongoDB to enhance semantic search capabilities.
Designed dynamic prompting and retrieval workflows to improve response relevance and generation quality.
Contributed to data preparation, prompt engineering, and Kanban delivery for AI reporting workflows.
